items.claim: Stephanie Luciano is the more well-rounded fighter in her matchup against Marina Spasić.
items.quote: I like Stephanie Luciano. I think she's the more well-rounded fighter.

items.claim: Hailey Cowan tends to slow down as her fights progress and looks her best in the first round.
items.quote: Hailey Cowan is one of these girls she does slow down as fights progress. She's going to look her best in round one.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec is tough, durable, and hard to get out of a fight.
items.quote: you look at Kyle Prepolec, he's a tough son of a [__] He is hard to get out of there. He has the heart, he has the determination, he has the grit.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec took his previous short-notice fight against Benoît Saint-Denis and made it past the first round and a half.
items.quote: he took that fight on short notice against a top-ranked guy in Benoît Saint-Denis, and he still made it over a round and a half.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki is nearly impossible to finish or stop in a fight.
items.quote: Mateusz Rebecki is basically impossible to kill. I mean, you have to get out of there. You got to kill him to literally get him out of there.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira is a Brazilian jiu-jitsu blue belt with zero submission wins on his record.
items.quote: Michael Oliveira is a blue belt in BJJ. He's zero and zero to the sub.

items.claim: Oban Elliott suffered a submission loss in his most recent fight.
items.quote: we did see Oban Elliot lose by sub in his last fight.
